test_launch_function: test the launch runner by spawning a subprocess that writes a random string to a temp file
run_launch_subprocess: run a subprocess using the launch function with command-line arguments and wait for completion
create_temp_file_for_test: create a temporary file using NamedTemporaryFile for use in subprocess launch testing
generate_random_string: generate a random string of specified length using the random_string utility function
write_string_to_file: write a string argument to a file specified as a command-line argument via the main entry point
